CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE

1. Which response best shows understanding of Monarchy in Israel: King David? (1 mark)

   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Monarchy in Israel: King David.
   C. Apply the teaching of Monarchy in Israel: King David with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Monarchy in Israel: King David has no place in daily life.
